Title: The Hollow Crown
Prologue: Last winter the Old Throne stood empty, and the Chronicle's pages for that winter were lost. A new season opens. Someone must fill the Hollow Crown.
Epilogue: The pages of the lost winter stay blank, and the realm must write its own. You have written your part, and the Chronicle remembers it.

Chapters.Title: The Empty Seat
Chapters.Intro: The seat is empty and the crown is hollow. Under the Charter anyone may sit an empty throne. First the realm must learn who stands with whom.
Chapters.Outro: The seat has a sitter, or it waits. Either way the realm has chosen sides, and the Chronicle has begun to write.

Steps.Title: Ash at the Hearth
Steps.Text: Every season begins at the Hearth, where the Charter was sworn. Go and warm your hands at the great fire, and walk the waking realm.
Steps.Done: The fire has not gone out in a hundred winters. It will not go out on your watch.

Objectives.Text: Warm your hands at the Hearth
Walk the realm, in active minutes

Steps.Title: Under a Banner
Steps.Text: No one sits the throne alone. Found a house or join one, and stand under its banner when the realm counts its friends.
Steps.Done: You have a banner now, and the banner has you. Both of you will be judged by the other.

Steps.Title: A Roof Before Winter
Steps.Text: A house without a roof is a rumour, and rumours do not last a winter. Raise walls for your house, block by block.
Steps.Done: Walls and a roof. In Ostreval, that is the first argument a house ever wins.

Steps.Title: Bend the Knee, or Stand
Steps.Text: Oaths bind the realm together and treaties keep it from bleeding. See your house swear, seal or found, or keep the Truce at its gathering.
Steps.Done: The realm knows where you stand. It will hold you to it.

Objectives.Text: Your house swears or accepts an oath
Found a house of your own
Keep the Truce of the Realm at its gathering

Steps.Title: The First Sitting
Steps.Text: Someone will sit the Old Throne first, and the realm will argue about it for a season. Stand on the throne hill, or stand on Crown Night.
Steps.Done: You saw the seat with your own eyes. Most who talk about it never have.

Chapters.Title: The Charter Tested
Chapters.Intro: A crown that only sits is still hollow. Now the monarch must govern, with laws, a court, a treasury, and lists where the realm's best blades are weighed.
Chapters.Outro: Laws are read, coin changes hands and the lists have their champion. The realm has seen how this crown governs. Now it will answer.

Steps.Title: Coin at the Crown Market
Steps.Text: The stalls are rebuilt on the Builders' foundations. Walk the Crown Market, and carry a purse worth opening there.
Steps.Done: The traders watched your purse the whole way round. That is how you know it is full.

Steps.Title: Ink on the Board
Steps.Text: Merchants post their first contracts. Fill an order, collect a bounty or fight as a hired sword, or bring stone for the new stalls.
Steps.Done: Your word is on the board and good. In a market, that is worth more than coin.

Objectives.Text: Or hand in stone for the stalls

Steps.Title: The Lists of the Charter
Steps.Text: On Fridays the realm's champions fight for Ashgrove's wreath of oak. Take part in the Royal Tournament, or stand at the Listing Field.
Steps.Done: You have seen the Stone and the wreath. One day, perhaps, the wreath will see you.

Objectives.Text: Take part in the Royal Tournament
Or stand at the Listing Field

Steps.Title: Steel for the Charter
Steps.Text: Laws need enforcers and enforcers need steel. Forge weapons fit for a court's champion.
Steps.Done: Three blades for the realm's justice. Pray they are drawn rarely.

Steps.Title: Bricks for the Court
Steps.Text: The court sits for the first time and has no hall to sit in. Bring clay for its bricks and lay stone for its floor.
Steps.Done: The court has a floor to stand on. What it builds on it is up to the crown.

Chapters.Title: The Lawful Hours
Chapters.Intro: Houses that were taxed, tried or passed over raise their claims at the Hearth. The Lawful Hours open, and the King's Hunt is loosed.
Chapters.Outro: The Night of Bells has rung. Whether the crown held or fell, every house now knows what one more crown day is worth.

Steps.Title: Into the Crown Wold
Steps.Text: By old custom the monarch's huntsmen keep the Crown Wold. Walk its dark paths and thin the wolves that hunt there.
Steps.Done: The Wold is a little less dark. The wolves that are left have learned your scent.

Steps.Title: The Lawful Hours
Steps.Text: When a claim is raised the realm fights for the throne in the Lawful Hours. Stand on Crown Night, or meet a foe of another house in the field.
Steps.Done: You stood when the realm stood. The Chronicle may not name you, but your house will.

Objectives.Text: Or defeat a foe of another house

Steps.Title: The King's Quarry
Steps.Text: The crown names a quarry and looses the realm on them. Ride with the King's Hunt, take the quarry, or bring down two foes of other houses.
Steps.Done: The Hunt is over for now. The crown keeps a list, and so, it seems, do you.

Steps.Title: The Ransom-Pits
Steps.Text: In the Ember Pass, Halloran keeps the old ransom-pits swept, in case the Charter changes its mind. See them, and bring the forges iron.
Steps.Done: The pits are empty and the forges are fed. Halloran calls that a good week.

Chapters.Title: The Reckoning at the Hearth
Chapters.Intro: The season's ledger is nearly closed. Every house can read the standings, and every house knows what is left to win.
Chapters.Outro: The ledger is closed. What is written in it will be read at the Hearth when the season ends.

Steps.Title: The Ledger is Read
Steps.Text: Earn your house its place in the standings. Help it meet a weekly goal, or finish two weekly tasks of your own.
Steps.Done: Your line in the ledger is written in a steady hand.

Objectives.Text: Help your house meet a weekly goal

Steps.Title: The Last Crown Night
Steps.Text: The last Crown Night falls on the final Saturday. Fight for the throne or guard it, and let the Chronicle name who held.
Steps.Done: The last night is fought. Whoever sits the seat now sits it into the Hall of Kings.

Objectives.Text: Stand on the last Crown Night

Steps.Title: The Hearth Truce
Steps.Text: On the last Sunday the realm gathers at the great fire without blades, every house under its banner. Be there.
Steps.Done: No blood at the Hearth. The fire burns, the banners stir, and the season is nearly told.

Objectives.Text: Keep the Truce of the Realm
